summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests fianlimab and cemiplimab, with or without ipilimumab, or ipilimumab plus nivolumab, as first-line treatment for advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma. All drugs are given by IV, patients are randomized 2:2:1 to three arms, and the treatment schedule and length are not stated. The main outcome is not stated; the record describes this as a randomized Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa fianlimab y cemiplimab, con o sin ipilimumab, o ipilimumab más nivolumab, como tratamiento de primera línea para el carcinoma de células renales avanzado de células claras. Todos los medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa, los pacientes se asignan al azar en una proporción 2:2:1 a tres grupos, y el calendario y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro describe este estudio como un ensayo aleatorizado de fase 2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
Karnofsky performance status of 70% or higher within 14 days before registration.
Kidney cancer that cannot be cured by surgery or radiation, or is metastatic (stage IV).
No prior systemic therapy for kidney cancer, including neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy.
Measurable disease according to RECIST 1.1 within 28 days before registration.
not_for: Prior systemic treatment for kidney cancer in the neoadjuvant, adjuvant, or metastatic setting.
Any condition needing ongoing prednisone of 10 mg per day or more.
Autoimmune disease needing immunosuppressive treatment within the past 2 years.
Central nervous system (brain) metastases, as described in the protocol.
